notes: Extracted from the guide at e7ed622 and docs/evidence/pdpcccard.md. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror tag v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02). The evidence and the guide's Sources note were checked on 21 October 2026 on v0.1.78-c7d3348; the evidence says dbe0e02 also changed PdpCcCard for #361 and this guide's copy wasn't re-checked, so the gaps are recorded as seen on c7d3348 and wait for #361's re-test (four name #361; the numberOfLines ellipsis gap names no ticket in the evidence). Where the installed types contradict the 21 October evidence, the types win and the evidence is not used: title and subtitle now hide with '' or null (the evidence says there is no way to hide either), and singleLine is now clipped at the card edges (the guide's Don't says the title runs past both edges), so the singleLine pair takes its Do caption as the reason. The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty; the evidence's summary of Biscuit's Storybook page points to CcCard and ProductOverview, but the guide doesn't say it. Examples set no modes and use the guide's own sample content and picture.

    { title: 'Price', value: '₹31,200', caption: 'incl. GST', icon: 'ic_rupee_coin' },

/>

evidenceFacts.name: imageSource
evidenceFacts.description: The picture is shown with cover fit, its corners from image/radius (8 px; the Radius mode changes them), and hidden from screen readers.
evidenceFacts.quote: radius `image/radius` 8 (Radius mode), cover, hidden from screen readers.

evidenceFacts.name: metrics
evidenceFacts.description: One equal-width column per entry, each announced as “title, value, caption”. An empty list removes the row; there is no maximum.
evidenceFacts.quote: equal widths (`flex: 1`), each announced as "title, value, caption"

evidenceFacts.name: showButton
evidenceFacts.description: false removes the button and 44 px of the card's height.
evidenceFacts.quote: `showButton` (true; false removes 44 px)

evidenceFacts.name: button
evidenceFacts.description: Replaces the default Button; the node gets AppearanceBrand Secondary, Emphasis Medium and Button / Size S, with the card's own modes on top.
evidenceFacts.quote: `button` replaces the default Button and gets `{ AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary', Emphasis: 'Medium', 'Button / Size': 'S', ...modes }`.

evidenceFacts.name: onPress
evidenceFacts.description: The whole card becomes one button, named by accessibilityLabel, else title, and dims to 0.92 opacity while pressed. With the default button still showing, that nests a button in a button. The card has no disabled prop.
evidenceFacts.quote: `onPress` makes the whole card a `Pressable` (role button, name `accessibilityLabel ?? title`, opacity 0.92 when pressed); with the default Button that nests a button in a button. No `disabled`.

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: No mode changes the card's own white panel, padding or gap; modes reach the picture, title, metrics and button.
evidenceFacts.quote: The card's own tokens (`PDPcccard/*`: white, padding, gap) don't change with any mode.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceBrand
evidenceFacts.description: On the card it changes the button (Primary gold, Neutral grey, Tertiary blue) and the metric icons; left unset, the button and the icons are Secondary purple.
evidenceFacts.quote: AppearanceBrand: the button (Primary gold, Neutral grey, Tertiary blue) and the metric icons

evidenceFacts.name: Emphasis
evidenceFacts.description: Changes the button: High is solid purple with a white label, Low is text only, and Medium, light purple, is the card's default.
evidenceFacts.quote: Emphasis: the button (High solid `#5d00b5` with white label; Low text only; Medium light purple is the card's default).

evidenceFacts.name: Button / Size
evidenceFacts.description: Changes the button: M makes it 42 px tall; the card's default is S.
evidenceFacts.quote: Button / Size: the button (M 42 px)

evidenceFacts.name: Radius
evidenceFacts.description: Changes the picture's corners: None 0, M 16, L 32 (8 px by default).
evidenceFacts.quote: Radius: the image corners (None 0, M 16, L 32).
